summary: Groq's free tier serves open models at high speed through a rate-limited API at no cost — for example around 1,000 requests per day on GPT-OSS-class models. Rate limits vary per model and are published in Groq's docs.
claim_steps: Create a free Groq Cloud account at console.groq.com.
Generate an API key from the console's API Keys page.
Point your client at api.groq.com and pick a supported model.
Stay within the free rate limits listed at console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits.
